# FLX-3662: a response family names a document the bundle does not have, or one of the wrong kind

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

treatment names a Treatment of the bundle, experiment an Experiment with a variant whose treatmentRef is that treatment, journey a Journey, and each segments value a Segment. A reference that resolves to nothing, or to a document of another kind, would leave the family applying to nothing.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3662
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
